national_note: The Department's dataset and referendum.ie both give the national spoilt votes as 49,326, kept here as declared. Yes + No + 49,326 is 100 more than the declared total poll of 903,659; the constituency rows' spoilt votes sum to 49,226, which does add up, so the site's sum of constituency results shows 49,226.
